Browser control runs through this local bridge and the installed extension."},{"id":"p18s1","text":"## 03 · Core Features"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"| Feature | Current behavior |"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"| Existing tabs | Reuses regular HTTP/HTTPS and authorized local file:// tabs and their login state "},{"id":"p20s2","text":"in Chrome and Edge. |
| Native references | Lists page titles, sites and icons through DSH's `@` and"},{"id":"p20s3","text":" `/` menus. |
| Browser sidebar | Native left navigation opens a session-owned right panel for pages"},{"id":"p20s4","text":", running apps and local diagnostics. Picks append references to the current draft without sending. "},{"id":"p20s5","text":"|
| Compact context | Page/app context, annotations and manually referenced logs appear as expandabl"},{"id":"p20s6","text":"e chips; their serialized model context is preserved. |
| Compact reading | Accessibility snapshots "},{"id":"p20s7","text":"support selector/query narrowing and cursor pagination. Initial reference context shares a default 2"},{"id":"p20s8","text":",400-character budget. |
| Batched actions | Runs up to 12 typed actions per call, including uploads"},{"id":"p20s9","text":"; stops on failure/document navigation. Query/hash routes only continue observations or target-free "},{"id":"p20s10","text":"steps. |
| Result extraction | Returns selected `text`, `value` and `href` fields, with up to 20 row"},{"id":"p20s11","text":"s per extraction. |
| Scoped receipts | `summary` skips the next snapshot; `handle` returns a fresh "},{"id":"p20s12","text":"ID/cursor without text. `observation` explicitly narrows the post-action snapshot. Read the handle c"},{"id":"p20s13","text":"ursor before using element refs. |
| Final checks | Optional `expect` checks visibility, contained t"},{"id":"p20s14","text":"ext, an exact input value or exact URL once after the batch. The result stays separate from complete"},{"id":"p20s15","text":"d actions and does not replay effects. |
| File uploads | Hidden inputs, custom choosers and iframe "},{"id":"p20s16","text":"selectors; requires a selected tab and exact user-supplied absolute file paths. |
| Drag and drop | "},{"id":"p20s17","text":"Drag between elements in the same frame, or drop authorized local files and MIME data onto an elemen"},{"id":"p20s18","text":"t. |
| Network metadata | Explicit start/stop capture, 200-entry capacity, filtered pages of 10 (up "},{"id":"p20s19","text":"to 20). No query strings, credentials, headers or bodies. |
| Local diagnostics | Bounded in-memory "},{"id":"p20s20","text":"command stages, duration and error codes; disable, clear, export or explicitly add logs to the draft"},{"id":"p20s21","text":"es, duration and error codes; disable, clear, export or explicitly add logs to the draft. |
